input.prompt:
You review a set of behaviour specifications that will each be implemented, one after the other, on the same domain classes. Find specifications that cannot all be true together.

## Product intent
- Product type: game
- Audience: players who want to play a single-player minesweeper puzzle
- Goal: Let a player reveal cells on a hidden minefield without triggering a mine, using the classic rules, and win by clearing all safe cells.
- Scope: A playable minesweeper board with cell state, mine placement, adjacency counts, flagging, and win/lose detection.
- The model must cover: board grid and cell states (hidden, revealed, flagged); mine placement and adjacency counts; game session status (in progress, won, lost) and elapsed time; difficulty settings that define board size and mine count
- Do NOT model: user accounts and login; online multiplayer or matchmaking; leaderboards or persistent player profiles; payments or monetisation

## Specifications
- SPEC-001 [Beginner difficulty preset] (Difficulty): Given the difficulty presets are available When the player selects Beginner Then the new game board has 9 rows, 9 columns and 10 mines
- SPEC-002 [Intermediate difficulty preset] (Difficulty): Given the difficulty presets are available When the player selects Intermediate Then the new game board has 16 rows, 16 columns and 40 mines
- SPEC-003 [Expert difficulty preset] (Difficulty): Given the difficulty presets are available When the player selects Expert Then the new game board has 16 rows, 30 columns and 99 mines
- SPEC-004 [Board size and mine count fixed for the session] (GameSession): Given a game session is in progress at Expert difficulty When any board action is attempted Then the session rows, columns and mine count remain 16, 30 and 99
- SPEC-005 [New session starts in Ready state] (GameSession): Given the player has chosen a difficulty When a new game is started Then the session status is ready and elapsed_seconds is 0
- SPEC-006 [Mines placed after first reveal] (GameSession): Given a session in Ready state with no mines placed When the player reveals a hidden cell for the first time Then mines are placed at random and the session status becomes in-progress
- SPEC-007 [First revealed cell is never a mine] (GameSession): Given a session in Ready state When the player reveals cell (r, c) first Then cell (r, c) has has_mine false
- SPEC-008 [Exact mine count placed] (GameSession): Given a session with mine_count M is placed after the first reveal Then exactly M cells have has_mine true
- SPEC-009 [Adjacency count of a safe cell] (GameSession): Given a safe cell with exactly K mines among its eight neighbours When mines are placed Then the cell's adjacent_mine_count is K, where 0 <= K <= 8
- SPEC-010 [Edge and corner cells count only existing neighbours] (GameSession): Given a corner cell with 2 neighbours that are mines and 1 neighbour that is safe When adjacency is computed Then the cell's adjacent_mine_count is 2
- SPEC-011 [Zero count displays blank] (GameSession): Given a revealed safe cell with adjacent_mine_count 0 When the board is displayed Then the cell is shown blank
- SPEC-012 [Reveal a hidden unflagged cell] (GameSession): Given a hidden unflagged cell in a session in progress When the player reveals the cell Then the cell state becomes revealed
- SPEC-013 [Flagged cell cannot be revealed] (GameSession): Given a flagged cell When the player attempts to reveal the cell Then the cell state remains flagged and nothing else changes
- SPEC-014 [Revealed cell cannot be revealed again] (GameSession): Given a revealed cell When the player attempts to reveal the cell again Then the cell state remains revealed and the timer is unaffected
- SPEC-015 [Revealing a mine loses the game] (GameSession): Given a session in progress and a hidden unflagged cell with has_mine true When the player reveals the cell Then the session status becomes lost and ended_at is recorded
- SPEC-016 [Zero-count reveal spreads to neighbours] (GameSession): Given a hidden unflagged safe cell with adjacent_mine_count 0 When the player reveals the cell Then all eight neighbours that exist become revealed
- SPEC-017 [Spread repeats through connected zeros and stops at numbers] (GameSession): Given a connected region of zero-count cells bordered by numbered cells When a zero-count cell in the region is revealed Then every cell in the region and its bordering numbered cells are revealed, and the numbered cells do not reveal their own neighbours
- SPEC-018 [Spread skips flagged cells] (GameSession): Given a zero-count cell next to a flagged cell When the zero-count cell is revealed Then the flagged cell remains flagged
- SPEC-019 [Toggle a flag on a hidden cell] (GameSession): Given a hidden cell When the player toggles the flag Then the cell state becomes flagged, and toggling again returns the cell state to hidden
- SPEC-020 [Revealed cell cannot be flagged] (GameSession): Given a revealed cell When the player toggles a flag on the cell Then the cell state remains revealed and the flag count is unchanged
- SPEC-021 [Flags do not reveal cells] (GameSession): Given a hidden cell next to a zero-count cell When the player flags the hidden cell Then no other cell changes state
- SPEC-022 [Flagging before first reveal keeps session in Ready] (GameSession): Given a session in Ready state When the player flags a hidden cell Then the session status remains ready and elapsed_seconds stays 0
- SPEC-023 [Win when every safe cell is revealed] (GameSession): Given a session in progress where the last hidden safe cell is revealed When the reveal completes Then the session status becomes won and ended_at is recorded
- SPEC-024 [Win does not require flags] (GameSession): Given a session in progress where all safe cells are revealed and no mine cell is flagged When the last safe cell is revealed Then the session status becomes won
- SPEC-025 [Loss exposes all mines] (GameSession): Given a session that has just been lost When the board is finalised Then every cell with has_mine true is exposed to the player
- SPEC-026 [Loss display of mines and wrong flags] (GameSession): Given a session that is lost When the board is displayed Then mine cells show black dots and flagged cells without a mine show a wrong-flag marker
- SPEC-027 [Abandon a game at any time] (GameSession): Given a session in Ready or in progress When the player abandons the game Then the session status becomes abandoned with no win or loss result and a new board is created at the same difficulty
- SPEC-028 [Timer starts at first reveal] (GameSession): Given a session in Ready state When the player reveals the first cell Then started_at is recorded and the timer begins counting
- SPEC-029 [Timer shows whole seconds] (GameSession): Given a session in progress for 75.6 seconds When the timer is displayed Then it shows 75
- SPEC-030 [Timer stops on win or loss] (GameSession): Given a session that has just been won or lost with elapsed_seconds 120 When time passes Then elapsed_seconds remains 120
- SPEC-031 [New game returns to Ready] (GameSession): Given a session that is won, lost or abandoned When the player starts a new game Then the status is ready, all cells are hidden, flag_count is 0 and elapsed_seconds is 0
- SPEC-032 [Session status transitions] (GameSession): Given a session that is won or lost When any action other than starting a new game is attempted Then the status remains won or lost
- SPEC-033 [Cell state transitions] (GameSession): Given a flagged cell When a reveal is attempted Then the cell does not move to revealed, and given a revealed cell When any flag action is attempted Then the cell does not move to flagged
- SPEC-034 [Mine counter equals mines minus flags] (GameSession): Given a session with 10 mines and 3 flagged cells When the mine counter is read Then it shows 7
- SPEC-035 [Mine counter may go negative] (GameSession): Given a session with 10 mines and 12 flagged cells When the mine counter is read Then it shows -2
- SPEC-036 [Board actions after game end are ignored] (GameSession): Given a session that is won or lost When the player reveals or flags any cell Then no cell state changes and elapsed_seconds is unchanged
- SPEC-037 [Input controls for reveal and flag] (GameSession): Given a hidden cell on the board When the player clicks or taps the cell Then a reveal is requested, and when the player right-clicks or long-presses the cell Then a flag toggle is requested
- SPEC-038 [Board tile appearance] (GameSession): Given a hidden cell and a revealed cell with count 2 When the board is displayed Then the hidden cell is a grey raised tile and the revealed cell is flat light grey with its number in green
- SPEC-039 [Flag marker appearance] (GameSession): Given a flagged cell When the board is displayed Then the cell shows a red flag marker
- SPEC-040 [Top bar layout] (GameSession): Given a game session is displayed When the top bar is rendered Then the mine counter is at the left, the status button in the centre and the timer at the right
- SPEC-041 [Status button face reflects game status] (GameSession): Given a session that is in progress When the status button is displayed Then it shows the smiley face, and given a session that is lost Then it shows the loss face
- SPEC-042 [Single player persona only] (GameSession): Given the game interface is open When the player views the screen Then no other user roles or role-specific controls are shown

Report only real contradictions: two or more specifications that demand incompatible results for the same situation (for example one says an inquiry is accepted when a field is missing and another says it is rejected). Do not report overlaps, duplicates, missing detail or style differences.

Respond STRICTLY with JSON, no commentary:
{"conflicts": [{"specs": ["<spec_id>", "<spec_id>"], "reason": "<one sentence naming the incompatible demands>"}]}
Use an empty list when there are none.

output: {"conflicts": [{"specs": ["SPEC-016", "SPEC-018"], "reason": "SPEC-016 requires every existing neighbour of a revealed zero-count cell to become revealed, while SPEC-018 requires a flagged neighbour to remain flagged when such a cell is revealed."}, {"specs": ["SPEC-017", "SPEC-018"], "reason": "SPEC-017 requires every cell in the zero region and its bordering numbered cells to be revealed, while SPEC-018 requires a flagged bordering cell to remain flagged."}]}
